hooks.command: test "$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" != 'main' || { echo '{"block": true, "message": "Cannot edit files on main branch. Create a feature branch first."}' >&2; exit 2; }
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.go ]]; then gofmt -w "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; goimports -w "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.go ]]; then go vet "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 || true; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.go ]]; then golangci-lint run --fast "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *_test.go ]]; then go test -race -v "$(dirname $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH)/..." 2>&1 | tail -30 || true; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.proto ]]; then cd "$(dirname $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH)" && buf lint 2>&1 || true; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.tsx ]] || [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.ts ]]; then npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.tsx ]] || [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.ts ]]; then cd "$(dirname $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH)" && npx eslint --fix "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.tsx ]] || [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.ts ]]; then cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || dirname $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH)" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.proto ]]; then cd "$(dirname $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH)" && buf breaking --against '.git#branch=main' 2>&1 | head -10 || true; fi
